headline: Solflare Pledges to Cover Missed Rewards on $160 Million Staked Solana
summary: Solana wallet Solflare announced it will pay missed staking rewards on roughly 1.56 million SOL, valued at $160 million, after an unidentified validator holding its keys went offline and stopped earning.
why: Solflare is one of the primary non-custodial wallet providers supporting the Solana network. Staking rewards and validator uptime are fundamental to network security and capital efficiency in proof-of-stake blockchains.

impacts.name: Solana
impacts.why: Reimbursement pledges limit financial losses for stakers, though offline validator incidents highlight operational risks in staking infrastructure.
